title: Concept: Maven dependency without a version
description: pom.xml declares a dependency that declares no version and no import scope, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Maven takes the version from whatever parent or BOM happens to be in scope, so a parent change silently moves the dependency.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: Maven takes the version from whatever parent or BOM happens to be in scope, so a parent change silently moves the dependency.
